tasks.title: Install the check toolchain: Vitest and Stylelint with the ADR-0003 rule set
tasks.dod: npm run lint runs stylelint over src/**/*.{css,astro} with the ADR-0003 rule set and exits 0 on the repo; npm run test:unit runs Vitest in CI; a Vitest fixture test shows every banned literal reported with file and line while token-only CSS passes.

tasks.title: Ship the seven brand faces and their metric-matched fallback faces
tasks.dod: public/fonts holds the 7 brand woff2 files, each ≤ 30 KB with æ ø å and the en/em dashes (Vitest reads their cmap); tools/fonts computes the Arial and Roboto fallback overrides, verified by Vitest against the TTF metrics; src/styles/fonts.css holds only the @font-face rules.

tasks.title: Generate tokens.css from the design sources with Dag, Natt and the no-JS Natt block
tasks.dod: node scripts/tokens/build.ts writes src/styles/tokens.css with the ADR-0001 block layout; Vitest proves a brand/handoff palette conflict fails naming token and both values, both Natt lists are identical, and a Natt-only token from any handoff file reaches both Natt blocks.

tasks.title: Extend the generator with reduced-motion tokens, fallback font stacks and --check mode
tasks.dod: tokens.css carries the reduced-motion overrides and --fjord-duration-fade and the font stacks with the fallback faces; generator --check fails naming the file when tokens.css is stale and runs in npm run lint; Vitest covers stale and fresh cases.

tasks.title: Add the contrast check over the generated tokens
tasks.dod: scripts/check-contrast.ts computes every manifest pair in Dag, Natt and on-spruce and runs in npm run lint; a Vitest fixture with a lowered pair fails naming pair, theme and measured ratio; the real tokens pass and both Natt blocks are asserted identical.

tasks.title: Port the handoff base.css as token-only element styles
tasks.dod: src/styles/base.css covers the element base (box sizing, page background and text, type, headings, links, :focus-visible, selection) using only --fjord-* tokens and allowlisted keywords; Stylelint reports zero findings; it declares no animation and only token-based transitions.

tasks.title: Add the theme bootstrap and the BaseLayout head contract, with the home placeholder on it (SCR-01)
tasks.dod: BaseLayout renders the sad §8 head order with the ADR-0001 bootstrap inlined first and exactly two font preloads; index.astro passes only title and description and renders SCR-01; npm run build succeeds and the existing smoke and a11y suites stay green.

tasks.title: Generate the bootstrap hash into a single /* CSP rule with a fail-closed build integration
tasks.dod: npm run build writes dist/_headers with one CSP line under /* carrying the bootstrap sha256 and no 'unsafe-inline'; Vitest fixtures for all four ADR-0002 fail rules pass, including the ld+json allowance; editing the bootstrap and rebuilding updates the hash with no manual edit.

tasks.title: Build the Fjord Not-found page (SCR-02) with the page-local home-link and ridge contours
tasks.dod: src/pages/404.astro renders every SCR-02 state from screens.md (code line 404 · Ikke funnet with lang=no, h1 Page not found, the body copy, the single primary Back to home link, static aria-hidden ridge), noindex, no See projects, no echoed path, no inline style; Stylelint is clean and home-link / ridge-contours are registered in docs/design-system.md.

tasks.title: Add the budget check for bootstrap, JS and font sizes
tasks.dod: scripts/check-budgets.ts runs after npm run build in CI and fails, naming file and size, when the bootstrap exceeds 1 KB, a page's initial JS exceeds 50 KB gzip, a page preloads other than exactly 2 fonts or more than 60 KB combined, or any shipped font exceeds 30 KB; a Vitest fixture proves each failure.

tasks.title: Cover the theme matrix end to end, including blocked storage and scripts off
tasks.dod: tests/e2e/theme.spec.ts passes for the 6 stored-choice × device combinations plus unknown value and blocked storage (data-theme set once, dag or natt, equal at first rAF and at load, color-scheme matching) and for scripts off with device light and dark.

tasks.title: Verify the delivered security policy end to end and flip P-16
tasks.dod: tests/e2e/headers.spec.ts asserts exactly one CSP header with the bootstrap hash and no 'unsafe-inline' on /, on a 404 response and on the EN CV PDF, and that an injected inline script is refused while the bootstrap runs; P-16 in parity.spec.ts is a passing test.

tasks.title: Verify font loading end to end and flip P-26
tasks.dod: tests/e2e/fonts.spec.ts proves only Schibsted 400 and 600 are requested before render, other weights load only when used, æ ø å render from the brand files at every design weight with no synthesized bold, and the Roboto fallback face renders while brand fonts are blocked; P-26 is a passing test.

tasks.title: Verify the Not-found page and reduced motion end to end and flip P-41
tasks.dod: tests/e2e/not-found.spec.ts asserts a 404 status, the SCR-02 content, noindex, a single link to / that reaches home, no See projects and no echoed path (also for a crafted path with markup), and that under reduced motion neither page has running animations; P-41 is a passing test.

tasks.title: Add axe checks in Dag and Natt and the Not-found visual baselines; capture the Natt references
tasks.dod: axe reports 0 violations on / and the Not-found page in Dag and Natt; tests/visual/not-found.spec.ts compares 390 / 834 / 1440 × Dag / Natt against Linux baselines at ≤ 0.1% differing pixels; the missing Natt reference screenshots are added to design/screenshots/ (roadmap D1).

tasks.title: Run Lighthouse on both pages with the Roboto-only runner and protect v2 and main
tasks.dod: CI installs Roboto and no Arial before tests and Lighthouse; npm run lhci on / and 404.html meets every spec §6 Lighthouse budget; branch protection on v2 and main requires the CI job and main allows no direct push, applied by the Owner and recorded in the PR.

tasks.title: Parse built HTML with a real parser in the CSP audit and hash a CRLF-normalised bootstrap
tasks.dod: The CSP audit walks a parsed DOM (htmlparser2 or parse5 devDependency, justified in the PR) instead of regexes; Vitest fixtures with data-src=, data-type="application/ld+json" and a '>' inside an attribute value before style=/onclick= each fail naming the page; the bootstrap text is read once, CRLF-normalised, and that same string is inlined and hashed; a Vitest case with a CRLF source still builds with a matching hash; .gitattributes sets src/scripts/*.js text eol=lf; build, lint, unit green.

tasks.title: Prove with a real rebuild that editing the bootstrap updates the delivered policy
tasks.dod: A Vitest integration test copies the site sources into a temp root, changes one character of the bootstrap, runs astro build there, and asserts the new sha256 is in dist/_headers and the old one is not; no edits outside the temp root.

tasks.title: Bootstrap without globals, one Norwegian language code, no viewport-fit, Norwegian 'Oslo, Norge'
tasks.dod: The bootstrap creates no global (window.t undefined after it runs) and the ADR-0001 snippet matches it; BaseLayout's lang prop uses 'no' (not 'nb'); the viewport meta has no viewport-fit=cover; home renders 'Oslo, Norge' inside an element with lang="no"; unit tests cover each; build, lint, unit green.

tasks.title: Close the token-only lint gaps: shorthands, units, size and radius, unknown tokens
tasks.dod: Fixtures for border-radius, size (font-size/width), keyword easing inside transition/animation, raw values in font/border shorthands, pt and other absolute units, viewport units outside the allowlist, and an undeclared var(--fjord-*) each fail naming file and line; token-only.css uses only declared tokens and passes; viewport units allowed only through an explicit property allowlist (e.g. min-height: 100dvh); npm run lint is clean on src/.

tasks.title: Not-found: unclipped focus ring, arrow icon from tokens, measured 44px target
tasks.dod: .not-found no longer clips its children (the ridge clips itself); an e2e check shows the focused 'Back to home' outline box lies inside the section and the link's rendered height is >= 44px at 390 and 1440; the arrow's size and stroke come from --fjord-icon-sm / --fjord-icon-stroke in CSS; build, lint, unit, e2e green.

tasks.title: Make reduced-motion tokens fail loudly and add the base reduced-motion guard
tasks.dod: The generator matches motion tokens by an anchored name pattern, throws on a matched value that is not a plain number, and resets scale tokens by how the handoff uses them (factor -> 1, delta -> 0); a unit test asserts no reduced-motion token can make an element invisible; base.css under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce sets animation-iteration-count: 1 and scroll-behavior: auto on all elements; tokens:check, lint, unit green.

tasks.title: Keep the Dag warning pair visible as a named known contrast failure
tasks.dod: warning on warning-soft and text on warning-soft are in the manifest; the check treats the warning pair as a named known failure (it must fail, by name, or the check errors) and prints pair, theme, ratio and 'known failure, fix before step 7 Callout' on every run; text on warning-soft passes normally; check:contrast and unit green.

tasks.title: Assert drawn brand fonts with scripts off and measure text runs in the font-swap test
tasks.dod: The scripts-off e2e asserts via CDP CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode that h1 is drawn with the custom Schibsted Grotesk face; the font-swap test compares text-run rects (Range) and baselines, not block boxes; each strengthened assertion is shown to fail against a deliberately broken variant (fonts blocked / wrong size-adjust) before being kept.

tasks.title: Make missing visual baselines fail CI and add a manual baseline workflow
tasks.dod: In CI a missing Linux baseline fails the visual test instead of skipping (only an explicit write mode proceeds without one); a workflow_dispatch workflow builds the site, runs the visual suite in the official Playwright Docker image with --update-snapshots and uploads the PNGs as an artifact; the CI baseline step with continue-on-error is removed. Baselines themselves are committed by the Owner after reviewing them.

tasks.title: Run Lighthouse CI against wrangler dev so the delivered headers apply
tasks.dod: lighthouserc.cjs starts wrangler dev on dist/ and audits / and a missing path; CSP, HSTS and the 404 handling are in effect during scoring; CI uses it.

tasks.title: Remove the stray screenshots and ignore mangled temp paths
tasks.dod: UsersUserAppDataLocalTemp/ is removed from the repo and a .gitignore rule keeps such mangled Windows temp paths out.

tasks.title: Produce the visual baselines from a labelled PR and document the local Docker fallback
tasks.dod: visual-baselines.yml also runs on pull_request types [labeled, synchronize], only when the PR has the `visual-baselines` label; it builds, writes the baselines in the official Playwright image and uploads the PNGs as an artifact. The README documents the equivalent local docker run command (FJORD_VISUAL=write) as a fallback, not the main path. After the Owner reviews and commits the 6 PNGs under tests/visual/__screenshots__/linux/ and removes the label, the CI visual job is green without continue-on-error and T15 moves to done.

tasks.title: Require both check and visual, and record the branch-protection commands
tasks.dod: T16 records the exact gh api commands: v2 requires check and visual now; main either now with enforce_admins false (a stub hotfix stays possible before Release 1) or as part of the Release 1 step, the Owner picks. ci.yml carries a comment that check and visual must have no path filters or job-level conditions on PRs into v2/main (a required check that never reports blocks the merge forever). The commands go into the PR; the Owner runs them.

tasks.title: Run the handler and style checks on every element in the CSP audit
tasks.dod: The script branch of auditPage no longer uses continue; the on*= and style= checks run for every element, including ld+json scripts and the bootstrap copy. The F-06 it.each in csp.test.ts gains: ld+json with onload, the bootstrap with onerror, ld+json with style; each is reported.

tasks.title: Measure the font swap at phone width and assert the Mono labels and body face
tasks.dod: fonts.spec.ts creates its contexts from the project use settings (or measures explicitly at 390 and 1440), so the font-swap rows run at phone width. After document.fonts.ready on the Not-found page, platformFonts reports JetBrains Mono for .code and Schibsted Grotesk for main p.

tasks.title: Make the no-global bootstrap test see top-level let bindings
tasks.dod: theme-bootstrap.test.ts runs the snippet in a vm.createContext context and asserts typeof t is undefined there (or runs it twice in one context without error); an unwrapped `let t` variant fails the test.

tasks.title: Disallow container-query units and restrict viewport heights by value
tasks.dod: stylelint.config.js disallows cqw/cqh/cqi/cqb/cqmin/cqmax; height, min-height and max-height accept only tokens, auto, % and 100vh/100svh/100lvh/100dvh. Fixtures with 50cqi and 73vh fail, naming file and line; src/ still lints clean.

tasks.title: Classify scale tokens by handoff usage and reject movement tokens outside motion.css
tasks.dod: generate.ts classifies each *-scale token from the handoff CSS: scale(var(--x)) is a factor (reduced to 1), calc(1 + var(--x)) is a delta (reduced to 0); it throws when neither is found and when a rise/slide/parallax/scale token is declared outside motion.css. Unit tests cover factor, delta, unclassified and misplaced tokens; tokens:check passes.

tasks.title: Record that SEO is not asserted on the noindex Not-found page
tasks.dod: spec §6 (Lighthouse categories) and §7 (Lighthouse KPI) state that SEO is not asserted on the noindex Not-found page because the crawlability audit fails a noindex page by design; lighthouserc.cjs keeps it off. The PR lists it among the deviations.

tasks.title: Make the measure tokens font-independent so text does not rewrap when the brand fonts swap in
tasks.dod: The token generator emits --fjord-measure and --fjord-measure-narrow in rem, converted from the handoff ch values with the advance width of "0" in Schibsted Grotesk (taken from the font file's metrics, not a literal), with a unit test for the conversion; tokens:check stays in sync; the comment at tests/e2e/fonts.spec.ts:160-162 is corrected; the font-swap run-width tolerance stays at 5 %; the Not-found page looks the same at 390 / 834 / 1440.

tasks.title: Fix baseline-run concurrency, document the label and download, then run CI and the label flow
tasks.dod: visual-baselines.yml sets concurrency on the baselines job, not the workflow; the README and T16 include `gh label create visual-baselines` and `gh run download <id> -n visual-baselines-linux -D tests/visual/__screenshots__/linux`; the Owner pushes the branch, `check` is green (run ID recorded), the label flow produces the baselines, they are committed, and `visual` is green (run ID recorded).

tasks.title: Audit both the scripting-off and scripting-on parse trees in the CSP audit
tasks.dod: applyCsp audits each page parsed with scriptingEnabled false and true, merges the problems without duplicates and counts the bootstrap copies per tree; the <noscript><title></noscript><script>…</script></title></noscript> probe (and a <textarea> variant) is added to the F-06 it.each and fails.

tasks.title: Amend ADR-0003 to match the stylelint rules added by R17
tasks.dod: ADR-0003 lists the container-query units among the disallowed units and the height properties with their value grammar (tokens, auto, %, 100vh/svh/lvh/dvh, calc(token * n)), and records the calc(token * n) exception for heights, citing the T09 420 px mapping.

tasks.title: Upload the Lighthouse reports and move upload-artifact to Node 24
tasks.dod: The CI Lighthouse upload sets include-hidden-files: true and if-no-files-found: error so the .lighthouseci/ reports reach the `lighthouse` artifact; every actions/upload-artifact use is v7 (runs.using node24); the next CI run shows the artifact and no Node.js 20 deprecation warning.
